technical.summary: Mixed momentum signals with short-term bullish technicals (RSI, MACD crossover) are undermined by price positioning below key moving averages, weak trend strength (ADX 18.35), and negative volume/accumulation indicators.

fundamental.summary: MAR shows no insider buying, no institutional accumulation, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 22 days—insufficient fundamental or smart money conviction to support a trade.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (19/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but mixed congressional activity (1 sale, 1 purchase, 1 sale) and absent news sentiment provide no confirmation.

risk.summary: Severe macro deterioration: inverted yield curve signals recession, VIX at crisis levels (344.6), strong dollar headwinds for discretionary consumer stocks, CPI event in 1 day adds binary risk, and earnings in 22 days create compounded uncertainty.

debate.key_bull_argument: RSI rising, MACD bullish crossover, and supertrend confirmation with extreme fear sentiment (19/100) create a contrarian entry near support (132.20) ahead of potential mean reversion.
debate.key_bear_argument: Price trapped below all major moving averages with weak ADX (18.35), negative volume (CMF, OBV, AO), zero fundamental conviction, inverted yield curve, VIX crisis levels, and binary CPI/earnings risks within 23 days make this a high-risk, low-conviction setup.

decision.entry_rationale: Short-term technicals (RSI rising, MACD crossover) and extreme fear sentiment (19/100) create a contrarian setup at support, but this is overwhelmed by price trapped below all major moving averages, weak trend strength (ADX 18.35), and zero fundamental conviction.
decision.primary_risk: Inverted yield curve, VIX crisis levels (344.6), and binary CPI event in 1 day combined with earnings in 22 days create compounded macro and event risk that far exceeds the weak technical setup.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case dominance
